017package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.runreport;
018
019import org.apache.juneau.rest.server.runreport.RunEvent.*;
020
021/**
022 * One test recovered from a report.
023 *
024 * <p>
025 * A reader cannot build a {@code RunEvent} directly because a test event needs a step id, which the caller supplies
026 * later through {@link ReportResult#toEvents(String)}.
027 *
028 * @param suite The suite name (a class name or a file path).
029 * @param name The test name.
030 * @param status The test status.
031 * @param ms The duration in milliseconds, or <jk>null</jk>.
032 * @param msg The failure message, or <jk>null</jk>.
033 * @param trace The stack trace, or <jk>null</jk>.
034 */
035public record ReportTest(String suite, String name, TestStatus status, Long ms, String msg, String trace) {}
